app.name: Geezy
app.long_description: Hold sideways. A: two-second charge, compression and voxel lock; release for 1.2-4x impulse. B: full-screen overdrive and eased inversion graphics. 1: palette. 2: five anchored trinity formations and four travel styles. Smooth chrome gyros, spike clusters, double cages, nested frames, a polygon tunnel and an infinite lattice. Orbit/dolly camera, RGB split and corner telemetry. D-pad: tap for directional impulse, hold for 5x boost, faster subject spin and off-center aim. B + D-pad: look away; release to return. Plus/Minus: speed and density gear 0-3. Plus and Minus together: reset. Optional shake: 2.5x impulse. HOME: exit. No sensor bar required.
